overlap_rationale: All demonstrated actions are retained. Adjacent datasets deliberately duplicate supervised actions, not merely observation context. open_hinged_lid and retrieve_peg_from_box share [740,950) in every trajectory: 210 actions = 10.5 s per occurrence, 2,520 actions total. This covers the last lid swing, lid release, clearance, and transit toward the still-stationary peg, so the receiver can start before or after release; the lid is the object being released while the peg is the intended next object. retrieve_peg_from_box and reorient_and_stage_peg share [1120,1270): 150 actions = 7.5 s per occurrence, 1,800 actions total. This covers grasp consolidation, lift out of the box, clearance, and the beginning of turning/transport. reorient_and_stage_peg and align_and_insert_peg share [1380,1500): 120 actions = 6.0 s per occurrence, 1,440 actions total. This covers final axis alignment, motion above the hole, descent to hole height, and early insertion. At 20 Hz these regions are much longer than the 8-action execution chunk and 16-slot prediction horizon, providing multiple supervised switch timings. Broad transition behavior was inspected in demo12200 across 700-1180 and 1200-1555, with synchronized boundary states checked separately in all 12 trajectories. The expected benefit is handoff tolerance; the successful demonstrations do not establish recovery from unseen misses, drops, collisions, or a reclosed lid.
